instruction: Keep the root order unchanged before applying allographs.
At a card onset q may carry an O-frame without adding meaning.
Render OK with qok-, ok- or the learned chok- frame.
Render OT with ot- or qot-; q is a carrier choice.
Render OL with ol-, chol-, qol-, ls- or sol- from the local deck.
Render CH/CHD/CHK/CKH inside the operation body with ch/ched/check variants.
One, two or three visible e grades encode E, EE or EEE where the frame licenses it.
Render AIIN/AIN/AL/AR/AIR at the right argument, address or path edge when available.
Use l- as the ordinary transfer/path onset.
Use r- as the cool-state onset.
Use the learned y/chy/chey/dy/shy/sy open-post allograph licensed by the card family.
Use a learned -dy close only for recipes whose final component is DY.
Copy diagram-local carriers or contractions as well as address, label and material signs.
Copy TALAM as the sole learned whole-root spelling.
Repeat a root visibly when the recipe repeats the same address or referent.
